feeds.title: Angie Quilts
feeds.description: Basically, this blog is a diary with pictures. It follows patchwork and quilting projects made by myself in my Quilty Quarters, and those made by all the lovely people who come to classes and workshops. There will be quite a few snippets about daily life in my very own quilt shop too.

feeds.title: Quilts By Lisa Watson Blog
feeds.description: Lisa Watson makes distinctly British Quilts Cushions & More for your home. Keep up to date with developments at quilt towers at By Lisa Watson Blog.

feeds.title: Fabadashery Longarm Quilting
feeds.description: Longarm Quilting Service by Frances Meredith based in the UK, serving quilters locally in Bristol, the Forest of Dean, Gloucestershire, Wiltshire, Herefordshire, Somerset, South Wales, Monmouthshire and Gwent.

feeds.title: The Crafty Nomad: Monthly Quilt Pattern Subscription Club Blog
feeds.description: Hi I'm Jo Westfoot, the owner of The Crafty Nomad. I love to sew and quilt and generally 'make stuff'! I write sewing tutorials and patchwork quilt patterns. You'll find the patterns here along with other fun sewing related things!

feeds.title: Nicola Foreman Quilts
feeds.description: Hi welcome to my quilting blog! I live in the UK in Suffolk, near the coast, surrounded by beautiful countryside. My passions are my family, my dog, my friends and sewing, not necessarily in that order!

feeds.title: Patchwork, Quilting and Craft Workshops and Retreats
feeds.description: Stay up to date with latest articles from Fiona Garth's blog.

feeds.title: Susie's World | Quilt Creations!
feeds.description: Welcome to my Blog. The Blog is supposed to be about quilting, which I love to do and am getting better at (!) I first started quilting in 2010. I have always loved to sew, having been taught by my Grandmother when I was young, but quilting had always fascinated me so when we went to the US for the second time in 2010 I bought some fabric and set off on my quilting journey.

feeds.title: PlainStitch Deb
feeds.description: I make quilts, study quilts, and write about their history deep in the English countryside. I'd say it was a hobby, but it's clearly a compulsion.

feeds.title: Charm About You
feeds.description: Lucy's passions are combining fabric, playing with quilt layouts and hand sewing. A quilter and blogger at 'Charm About You', she regularly teaches quilting classes and is a designer on The Sewing Quarter. Follow for projects, tips, patterns and tutorials.

feeds.title: Welsh Quilts
feeds.description: Welsh quilts, Durham quilts and the British tradition of bellringing. I am a quilter living in Woodbridge, Suffolk who has made quilts since I was a teenager. I also ring bells! Both are great British traditions. I will try to feature some of my antique Welsh and Durham quilts, the quilts I make myself, my quilting activities and also some of my bellringing achievements.

feeds.title: A Little Happy Place
feeds.description: Hello, my name is Sarah, I'm a mum, wife, purveyor of pretty fabrics and trims, fabric addict, quilter, happy stitcher and home maker. My mission is to cherry pick the prettiest quilting fabrics, patterns, notions and trims possible.

feeds.title: fabric & flowers
feeds.description: Welcome to fabric & flowers! I love to stitch and include a beginners' Learn to Quilt series as well as tips, techniques and tutorials and patterns.

feeds.title: Midget Gem Quilts
feeds.description: A blog about my quilting but also a little lifestyle, knitting, reading and family history, just really about me.

feeds.title: MessyJesse
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Jessie Fincham, welcome to my blog Messy Jesse. This is a blog about quilting and sewing projects.

feeds.title: Lily's Quilts
feeds.description: Lynne from Lily's Quilts is a modern UK quilter and a quiltblogger. Stay up to date with latest articles from Lily's Quilts.

feeds.title: Gillian Travis Blog
feeds.description: I am a textile artist based in a small village in the South Pennines near Halifax. In 2007 I joined the Contemporary Quilt Group and started to make Journal Quilts. I have been making one a month since then and currently have at least 120.

feeds.title: Verykerryberry
feeds.description: Hi, I am Kerry and this blog records my sewing and quilting life and a few other things as the mood takes me. I live in Exeter, a small city in Devon, close to the South West coast in the UK.

feeds.title: London Modern Quilt Guild
feeds.description: The London Modern Quilt Guild formed in January 2012 and we have an active membership who are passionate about promoting modern quilting.

feeds.title: Borderline Quilter
feeds.description: I am a longarm quilter living in the beautiful Scottish Borders here on the family farm with my husband, our horses and all the other animals. For as long as I can remember I have always loved to sew, now I love to quilt!

feeds.title: Sarah Payne Quilter - Happiness is a bottomless button box
feeds.description: My name is Sarah Payne and welcome to my blog - the meandering thoughts of a quilting nut trying to make a living following my creative bee.

feeds.title: The Cheshire quilter
feeds.description: Stay up to date with latest articles on quilting from The Cheshire quilter blog.

feeds.title: Bluepatch Quilter
feeds.description: Hi I am an enthusiastic quilter and love to share my love of this craft by teaching others. I started my blog as a way of keeping in touch with all the ladies who attend my classes. However, I have discovered the added bonus of a whole new community out there in blogland and am delighted to be taking inspiration and enjoyment from the many blogs I follow.

feeds.title: The Threadhouse
feeds.description: The Thread House is a UK based quilt design company with quarterly pattern releases and an annual quilt retreat.

feeds.title: The Quilt Sanctuary Blog
feeds.description: The Quilt Sanctuary is an online business offering Professional Quilting Services. We also have a small, but growing, selection of fabrics including extra wide backing fabric, wadding and basic quilting equipment.

feeds.title: Pinhole Quilting Blog
feeds.description: Pinhole Quilting is owned and run by Liz and Pete Holpin. Pinhole Quilting aims to be Europe's Premier Long-Arm Quilting Supplier and to use education and training and inspiration to create an inclusive quilting community.

feeds.title: Higham Piecemakers
feeds.description: Stay up to date with latest articles from Higham Piecemakers blog.

feeds.title: Feather On A Wire
feeds.description: A blog about quilting and quilts with some English life thrown in. My pleasures and frustrations of my quilting on a day to day basis.

feeds.title: Siblings Together Quilt Group
feeds.description: A group making quilts for siblings separated by the care system in the UK. I Sew Love to sew - mainly quilts, but sometimes clothes, bags and more.
